prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1335; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported in Houston, Texas. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision occurred.

A: I was driving on the freeway, in the right-hand lane, and I wanted to move over to the middle lane because I needed to take the next exit.

Q: Did you check your surroundings before changing lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. I didn't see anyone right beside me, so I started to move over.

Q: What happened next?

A: About halfway into the lane change, I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed toward the left. The other vehicle was alongside me in the middle lane, and our mirrors clipped. I think I was still going about the same speed as traffic.

Q: Did the other driver stop?

A: They pulled over onto the shoulder a little ahead. I pulled onto the shoulder behind them.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My left wrist hit the steering wheel and the door frame when the car jerked. It swelled up almost right away, and I was taken to the hospital. They told me it's fractured.

Q: Are you receiving treatment now?

A: I have a splint and I'm scheduled to see a hand specialist next week. I'm still having trouble gripping things.

Q: Is there anything else you want to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was trying to signal and move carefully. I didn't mean for this to happen, and I want to get my car repaired.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
